get.summary: Lists measurements in the authenticated company
get.description: Requires MEASUREMENTS.READ. Allowed filters: workId, contractId, reference, status, measuredOnFrom and measuredOnTo. Allowed sort fields: measuredOn, reference, status, createdAt and updatedAt. Default: measuredOn,desc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index. Must be greater than or equal to zero.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Allowed values: measuredOn, reference, status, createdAt or updatedAt, followed by asc or desc. Default: measuredOn,desc.

parameters.name: workId
parameters.description: Exact work identifier in the authenticated company.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: Exact contract identifier in the authenticated company.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match against the measurement reference.

parameters.name: measuredOnFrom
parameters.description: Inclusive first measuredOn date, in ISO-8601 format.

parameters.name: measuredOnTo
parameters.description: Inclusive last measuredOn date, in ISO-8601 format.

post.summary: Creates a measurement and its initial draft version
post.description: Currency is immutable. Standalone defaults to BRL; linked creation derives the contract currency when omitted and returns 409 if supplied differently. No currency conversion.

post.summary: Advances the measurement through sending, external acceptance and finalization
post.description: Sending and external acceptance are available before a work link. FINALIZE requires the measurement to be linked to both a work and a compatible contract. When recording an external rejection, externalAcceptanceNotes is required and correctionItemIds may contain active items from this version that need correction.

post.summary: Applies an accepted measurement service once to a compatible contract service
Adds a calculated item to a draft measurement version

202.description: Measurement item creation submitted for approval

post.summary: Creates a corrective draft revision from an accepted measurement item
post.description: The accepted item remains frozen. REPLACE copies the accepted version and replaces one line; VOID copies it and logically removes that line.

201.description: Corrective draft revision created with official totals

post.summary: Converts an accepted measurement item into a contract service exactly once
Inserts a calculated item after a draft measurement item
post.description: Atomically inserts a line after insertAfterItemId and renumbers only active lines. A pending approval never changes the official order or totals.

201.description: Item inserted and active order recalculated

202.description: Insertion submitted for approval without changing official order

post.summary: Validates an XLSX measurement-item synchronization without changing official data
post.description: Requires measurement update authority. The exported hidden Item ID column is the only stable synchronization key; itemNumber, service title and activity are never used as keys. Only DRAFT versions are eligible. Accepted or finalized versions require a new revision.

200.description: Preview, line errors and authoritative totals

post.summary: Confirms and atomically applies a previously previewed XLSX measurement-item synchronization
post.description: Requires the exact SHA-256 returned by preview. Direct authority applies all changes atomically; request authority returns 202 and leaves official items untouched until approval. Removed lines are logically inactive.

200.description: Spreadsheet synchronization applied with authoritative totals

202.description: Spreadsheet synchronization submitted for approval without changing official data

post.summary: Coordinates unapplied accepted increments using persisted destinations
post.description: Returns per-origin APPLIED/AWAITING_APPROVAL/AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED; it never composes unaccepted items.

delete.summary: Logically deletes a measurement without a contract
delete.description: Requires MEASUREMENTS.CANCEL. No row, version, item, document or audit event is physically deleted. A measurement linked to a contract cannot be cancelled and returns 409.

202.description: Cancellation submitted for approval; official status remains unchanged

200.description: Versions ordered by version number descending

get.summary: Returns one selected measurement version with its official items and totals
Streams an XLSX spreadsheet for a measurement version
get.description: MEASUREMENTS.EXPORT. Ten visible columns. Hidden stable item/service fields, exact decimal inputs, preview-only formulas and very-hidden measurement/version/currency metadata preserve DRAFT reimport. BRL/USD/EUR symbols are presentation only; metadata mismatch returns 409 on import. Accepted history is never edited.

get.summary: Streams an inline PDF preview of the official measurement spreadsheet
Lists stable service groups in a measurement version
Streams a PDF for a measurement version
get.description: MEASUREMENTS.EXPORT. Ten landscape columns, private emitter branding, centered title/service bands, wrapped activities and official version totals. Every monetary value carries the immutable BRL/USD/EUR symbol. No public URL or cross-version sum.

get.summary: Shows billed amount and balance only from services originated by the measurement version
Returns official accepted, billed and received amounts by measurement origin
get.description: Requires MEASUREMENTS.READ, BILLING.READ and RECEIVABLES.READ. Only accepted origins participate; draft, sent and pending versions never enter this projection.

get.summary: Shows external acceptance and internal composition state independently
Returns accepted history and the current advance grouped by continuous service
get.description: Requires MEASUREMENTS.READ. Includes accepted activities and the current advance under their stable continuousServiceId, even when the revision is empty. Proven migration artifacts retired without deletion are excluded; intentionally empty services remain. Only current DRAFT items are editable. Monetary totals are official decimal strings; finance is explicitly unavailable without its permissions or contract.

get.summary: Streams the complete accumulated XLSX report, read-only for import purposes
get.description: MEASUREMENTS.EXPORT. Ten visible columns, private tenant branding, stable continuous identities and official accepted/pending subtotals. BRL/USD/EUR presentation preserves decimal precision. This accumulated report is read-only and cannot be imported; use the current DRAFT version XLSX for synchronization.

get.summary: Streams an inline PDF preview using the same accumulated contents and financial snapshot
Streams the complete accumulated measurement PDF, including the identified pending advance
get.description: MEASUREMENTS.EXPORT. Ten landscape columns, private tenant logo with safe fallback, centered title/service bands, wrapped descriptions and repeated page headers. Every monetary value uses the immutable BRL/USD/EUR symbol. Official accepted/pending subtotals and accepted/received/remaining totals stay separate. Retired artifacts and corrective duplicates are excluded; historical reports keep their version scope.

get.summary: Lists supported monetary units in the authenticated company context
get.description: BRL is the default. Currency is immutable from creation, including drafts. Linked measurements inherit the contract currency if omitted. No exchange rates or conversion. Monetary JSON values remain canonical decimal strings with two places; symbols are presentation only. Consolidations must remain separated by currency.

get.description: Requires AUDIT.READ. actorDisplayName is a safe, human-readable name; actorEmail is a separate contact field when available. Before and after data are intentionally never returned.

pixReceiverCity.description: Confirmed city of the Pix key holder. Required with a Pix key for a static BR Code Pix QR; never inferred from the employee address.

primaryAddress.description: Marks this address as the employee's primary address

sourceServiceTemplateId.description: Optional immutable source template. On update it must match the service's existing source template.

AccessUserResponse.description: Company system user and its assigned access roles

companyOwner.description: True only for the immutable initial owner of this company

amount.description: Positive canonical decimal. The new titles must total exactly the current unpaid balance.

currency.description: Moeda ISO imutável. Padrão BRL; medição vinculada deriva a moeda do contrato quando omitida. Sem conversão.

externalAcceptanceNotes.description: Required and nonblank when RECORD_EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE records externallyAccepted=false.

correctionItemIds.description: Optional active item identifiers from this version when an external rejection requests corrections.

previewTotalWeightKg.description: Optional frontend preview. The backend recalculates and rejects an inconsistent value.

previewTotalAmount.description: Optional frontend preview. The backend recalculates and rejects an inconsistent value.

continuousServiceId.description: Stable continuous service of this measurement. Select the persisted ID to continue a service in later advances.

unitQuantity.description: Required and positive for a UNIT replacement, where it drives unitQuantity × unitPrice. Optional for other charge types as an operational count only; it does not affect their formula, weight or amount.

chargeType.description: UNIT requires unitQuantity and uses unitQuantity × unitPrice; it has no totalWeightKg.

unitQuantity.description: Required and positive for UNIT, where it drives unitQuantity × unitPrice. Optional for all other charge types as an operational count of executed pieces; in those types it does not affect the formula, weight or amount.

previewTotalWeightKg.description: Optional frontend preview. UNIT may omit it or send 0.0000.

previewTotalAmount.description: Optional frontend preview. The backend recalculates and rejects an inconsistent value.

spreadsheetHash.description: SHA-256 returned by preview and required unchanged on confirmation.

EmployeePaymentDetailsResponse.description: Complete payment reference, returned only after an explicit, audited request authorized by EMPLOYEES.VIEW_PAYMENT_DETAILS. Do not cache, export or log these values.

accountNumber.description: Complete bank account number. Sensitive; display only during the manual-payment interaction.

accountCheckDigit.description: Complete account check digit. Sensitive; display only during the manual-payment interaction.

pixKey.description: Complete Pix key. Sensitive; display only during the manual-payment interaction.

pixCopyPaste.description: Static BR Code Pix copy-and-paste payload, with CRC. It has no amount, charge, due date or financial identifier. Null for legacy Pix references until the confirmed holder name and city are provided.

pixQrCode.description: PNG QR Code as a data URL for the static Pix payload. It has no amount, charge, due date or financial identifier. Null when pixCopyPaste is null.

currency.description: Moeda ISO imutável. Padrão BRL; medição vinculada deriva a moeda do contrato quando omitida. Sem conversão.

AppliedEntityResponse.description: Record created or applied by an approved change request, when available

PlatformChargeTrustUnlockResponse.description: Overdue platform charge and its trust unlock availability

externalAcceptanceNotes.description: Safe operational description of the corrections requested externally.

totalWeightKg.description: Null when this service contains only non-weighted lines.

ChangeRequestEntityResponse.description: Safe human-readable projection of the record involved in a change request

ChangeRequestRequesterResponse.description: Safe requester projection scoped to the authenticated company; no storage keys or public URLs are exposed

employeeId.description: Linked operational employee in the same company, when available

photoUrl.description: Authenticated employee-photo endpoint; null without a linked employee photo

AuditEventResponse.description: Tenant-scoped audit event without before/after payloads

occurredAt.description: When the audited action occurred, always represented in UTC

actorUserId.description: Trusted actor identifier; null only for SYSTEM events

actorDisplayName.description: Safe, human-readable name for the audit timeline. Never contains an email address, UUID, or other technical identifier.

actorEmail.description: Actor contact email when available. This is separate from actorDisplayName and is null for SYSTEM or unavailable historical actors.

metadata.description: Only explicitly allow-listed, non-sensitive audit metadata
